review.rationale: Reviewed AGPL-to-AGPL adaptation of Cloud nine-axis resolver and independence tests. Node type erasure, owner/import/catalog paths and npm producer-pin check replace Cloud-specific .NET/image inputs. Compact runtime identity binds the full report by SHA-256; no sibling source is a build input. All unknown-source, alias, dirty/CI and retry-attempt checks remain. This successor (GOV.10) lets the build identity read the published @arcforges/proto build-identity ContractSet, which declares every schema subject with its own version, instead of the retired single-schema source receipt field; the package version never supplies a schema version. The producer owner, clean source, exact package pin, schema-source hash set and descriptor hashes are cross-checked against the installed source receipt. The same three authored targets change; the upstream Cloud identities and licence evidence are unchanged.
